rows.ja: AIデータセンター・IT企業

relations.text: 最大2.8GWの燃料電池を購入する意向
relations.text_en: Intends to procure up to 2.8GW of fuel cells, with an initial 1.2GW contracted

source.label: Bloom Energy の発表(2026年4月)
source.quote: Under a master services agreement, Oracle intends to procure up to 2.8 gigawatts (GW) of Bloom’s fuel cell systems.
source.note: 2.8GWは購入の意向で、契約済みは初期の1.2GWです。
source.note_en: Up to 2.8GW is an intent; the initial 1.2GW is contracted.

relations.text: 提携に伴う新株予約権をOracleに発行
relations.text_en: Issued Oracle a warrant tied to the partnership; exercised on May 1, 2026

source.label: Bloom Energy 10-Q(2026年第2四半期)
source.quote: On May 1, 2026 (the “Exercise Date”), Oracle completed a cashless exercise of the Warrant, resulting in the issuance of 1,905,433 shares of our common stock.

relations.text: AIインフラ向けに燃料電池を導入する契約
relations.text_en: Agreement to deploy fuel cells for AI infrastructure

source.label: Nebius ニュースルーム(2026年5月)
source.quote: the first project with 328 MW of installed capacity is expected to be operational this year
source.note: 328MWは稼働予定で、稼働済みではありません。

relations.text: 米国のデータセンター向けに100MW超(うち約75MWが稼働、約30MWが建設中)
relations.text_en: Over 100MW across U.S. data centers (about 75MW operating, 30MW under construction)

source.label: Bloom Energy の発表(2025年2月)
source.quote: The collaboration now exceeds 100MW of electricity capacity to support Equinix’s International Business ExchangeTM (IBX®) data centers across the United States.

relations.text: 米カリフォルニア州フリーモントのAIサーバー工場に、独立型マイクログリッドとして燃料電池を導入
relations.text_en: Fuel cells for an islanded microgrid at its AI server campus in Fremont, California

source.label: Bloom Energy の発表(2026年8月)
source.quote: Bloom will deploy fuel cell systems for an islanded microgrid at MiTAC’s AI server manufacturing campus in Fremont, California.

relations.text_en: Supply agreement for up to 1GW, with an initial 100MW order

source.label: Bloom Energy の発表(2024年11月)
source.quote: signed a supply agreement with American Electric Power (AEP) for up to 1 gigawatt (GW) of its products
source.note: 最大1GWの契約で、発表時に発注済みなのは100MWです。
source.note_en: Up to 1GW; 100MW was ordered at announcement.

relations.text: AEPは、固体酸化物形燃料電池100MWの購入契約を結んだ
relations.text_en: AEP signed a purchase agreement for 100MW of solid oxide fuel cells

source.label: AEP 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Devco executed a purchase agreement with Bloom Energy, acquiring 100 MWs of solid oxide fuel cells.

relations.text: AIインフラ向けに最大50億ドルを投じる戦略的提携
relations.text_en: Strategic partnership to invest up to $5B in Bloom fuel cells for AI infrastructure

source.label: Bloom Energy の発表(2025年10月)
source.quote: Brookfield will invest up to $5 billion to deploy Bloom’s advanced fuel cell technology.

relations.text: 資金枠を50億ドルから250億ドルへ拡大

source.label: Bloom Energy の発表(2026年6月)
source.quote: Brookfield increases its framework to finance power projects for AI infrastructure – from previously announced $5 billion to $25 billion
source.note: 資金枠であり、購入の確定注文ではありません。
source.note_en: A financing framework, not a firm purchase order.

relations.text: SoftBank GroupとBloom Energyが、日本でBloom Energy Serverを展開する折半出資の合弁会社Bloom Energy Japanを設立
relations.text_en: SoftBank Group and Bloom Energy established a 50/50 joint venture, Bloom Energy Japan Limited, to deploy Bloom Energy Servers in Japan

source.label: Bloom Energy の発表(2013年7月)
source.quote: SoftBank Group and Bloom Energy Corp. today announced the establishment of a 50/50 Joint Venture
source.note: 2013年の発表で、合弁会社の現状はこの資料では確認できません。
source.note_en: A 2013 announcement; the current status of the joint venture is not confirmed in this source.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
